items.text: Every screen is now set as a book page, with running heads, rubrics and a colophon.
items.alt: A running head, a double rule, a red rubric and a question under a large red initial appear one after another

items.text: The mark is a candle on a closed book; the flame moves while the advisers think.
items.alt: A drawn candle standing on a closed book inside an oval; its flame leans and straightens
